uv: Radial front cap; iris centre (0.5,0.5), limbus radius 0.42, neutral dark outer bleed. Corneal highlights are rendered, never painted.
template: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: production cat-eye diffuse texture, one flat square 1024x1024 bitmap. Primary request: a perfectly frontal, circular, anatomically realistic feline iris disc for {name}. Iris colours: {colours}. Composition: iris and dark limbal ring exactly centred at image centre; outside edge of the limbal ring at 42 percent of image width from the centre in every direction (84 percent diameter). A narrow black vertical slit pupil with softly pointed top and bottom ends at the exact centre. Fine interwoven radial iris stromal fibres, tiny natural pigment freckles and crypts, a subtly scalloped pupil border, highly detailed real feline iris anatomy. Flat evenly illuminated albedo with no lighting direction, no specular highlight, no reflection, no glint, no bright white spots, no photographic shadow and no ambient occlusion. The iris is a round flat texture, not a photograph of a sphere. Outside the iris is a completely neutral very dark charcoal bleed continuing uniformly to all four edges. No eyelids, lashes, fur, face, eyeball silhouette, labels, text, logos, borders or watermark. The geometric cornea will supply all highlights in the renderer; preserve rich natural iris detail without baking gloss.
